name: merged_abc_v1
hypothesis: A (fast_keywords), B (archetype_caps), C (inverted_index_selection) touch disjoint files and the capability-inference cost of B is offset by A+C's speedup. Compose all three.

mechanism.A: precompiled keyword cache (per-keyword regex/isPhrase) + LRU lowercase cache in keywords.ts
mechanism.B: archetype classifier + data-viz signal detector inferImplicitCapabilities stage in prompt-planner.ts (web families only)
mechanism.C: inverted-index family scorer with token-Set + 2-char-prefix prefilter in selection.ts

note: First-generation meta-harness winner. Every variant compiled, tested, and eval'd independently; final composition measured 5× for stability.
